definitions.explanation: Indicates something will happen in a short time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{間|ま}もなく⟦{到着|とうちゃく}します→到着する：02526_touchaku⟧。
{間|ま}もなく⟦{始|はじ}まります→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。

notes:
{間|ま}もなく means "soon" or "shortly"—more formal than もうすぐ.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {間|ま}もなく: soon, shortly (formal)
- ⟦もうすぐ→もうすぐ：01218_mousugu⟧: soon (casual)
- ⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧: immediately, right away
- ⟦そのうち→そのうち：00380_sonouchi⟧: before long, sometime (vague)

COMMON CONTEXTS:
Often heard in public announcements:
- {間|ま}もなく⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{参|まい}ります→参る：01322_mairu⟧ (The train will arrive shortly)
- {間|ま}もなく⟦{開演|かいえん}→開演：23500_kaien⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (The show will begin shortly)

ETYMOLOGY:
Literally "without interval" ({間|ま} = interval + もなく = without).
